summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by AstraZeneca PLC to disclose the FDA approval of Baxfendy (baxdrostat), a first-in-class aldosterone synthase inhibitor for hypertension. The filing is a routine regulatory announcement of a product approval, not a special situation event. No merger, acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or other corporate action is involved. The document provides clinical trial results and commentary but contains no deal terms, advisor appointments, or board recommendations. As a foreign issuer report on ordinary business progress, it does not qualify for any special-situation category.
